stack_notes.css: Grid with grid-auto-flow: dense; view-transition-name set on the clicked print only.
stack_notes.js: document.startViewTransition for the open and close; restore focus to the print on close.

name: Gallery filtered by thing
blueprint: Gallery that filters by the trade's own objects or job types (Kitchens, Bathrooms, Loft or Wedding, Christening, Funeral), with a row of filter buttons 2.75rem tall with 4px corners above a uniform 3-column grid of 4:3 photos, each with a caption line of where and when. The h2 at clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 2.25rem), text-wrap: balance. Corner radius 2px on photos.
motion: Filtering animates remaining items to their new positions via view transitions in 250ms; removed items fade.
still_check: Any still shows a filtered grid with captions.
mobile: At 375px 1 column; filters become a horizontal scroll row.
a11y: Filters are toggle buttons with aria-pressed; result count announced. Reduced motion: instant regrid.
avoid: Filters for categories with 1 item, captions that just repeat the filter, or infinite scroll.

stack_notes.css: CSS-only fallback with radio inputs and :has(); view-transition-name per item for animated regrid.
stack_notes.js: Optional startViewTransition around the DOM filter.

name: The week at a glance
blueprint: Schedule as a 7-column week grid, each day a column with its slots as blocks sized to their duration (1 hour = 3rem tall), labelled with what, who and places left in tabular figures. Today's column is outlined. The h2 at clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 2.25rem), text-wrap: balance, with week arrows. Max 72rem. Corner radius 2px on slot blocks; grid lines 1px.
motion: Changing week slides the grid one column-width toward the past or future in 240ms.
still_check: Any still shows the whole week with today marked.
mobile: At 375px it becomes a day-by-day list with a day switcher.
a11y: Grid is a table with day headers, or a list per day; full and past slots marked in text. Reduced motion: no slide.
avoid: Empty weeks shown as if busy, colour-only slot types, or a calendar embed that does not fit the brand.

stack_notes.css: CSS grid with grid-row spans from start time; logical slide direction so RTL weeks run from inline-start; mirror translate under :dir(rtl).
stack_notes.js: Week navigation fetches the next week's data; abort on unmount.

name: Next up board
blueprint: A departure-board style list of the next 6 things happening (classes, services, tours, collections) with time, what, where and status, each row 3.5rem tall, times at clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 2.25rem) in tabular figures. The h2 at clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 2.25rem), text-wrap: balance. Status values (On time, 4 places, Full, Moved to 3pm) in small caps. Dark ground. Corner radius 0; rows ruled.
motion: When the minute rolls past a row's time, that row slides up and out (300ms) and the next row joins at the bottom; status changes flip their characters in a 250ms per-row flip.
still_check: Any still shows 6 complete rows.
mobile: At 375px 4 rows, where moves under what.
a11y: A table; status changes announced politely only for rows the user pinned. Reduced motion: instant updates.
avoid: Fake live data, flicker on every update, or status colour without words.

stack_notes.css: Server-rendered table first; flips via CSS rotateX on row change.
stack_notes.js: Poll or SSE for updates; minute timer; clean up on unmount. Pitfall: keep transform-style: preserve-3d on every wrapper between the perspective root and the moving planes; one flat wrapper collapses the depth.

name: The one next step
blueprint: Closing call to action that names exactly what happens when you act: the h2 at clamp(2rem, 4.5vw, 3.5rem) with text-wrap: balance states the step (Book a 20-minute call), followed by 3 short lines on what happens next (We call you at the time you pick, no cost, you get a written plan) and a single button 3.25rem tall with 4px corners plus a plain phone fallback. Left-aligned at inline-start, max 40rem, on the page's ground. Corner radius 4px on the button.
motion: Button press depresses 1px with a darker fill in 120ms.
still_check: Any still shows heading, lines and button.
mobile: At 375px button full width.
a11y: Button is a link or submit with a descriptive name. Reduced motion: no press motion.
avoid: Two competing buttons, urgency timers, or a centred gradient banner.

stack_notes.css: Plain flow; :active transform. Pitfall: colours inside the scene come from tokens, never hard-coded values, so a dark or inverted theme recolours the whole scene.
stack_notes.js: None required.

name: Footer as the practical sheet
blueprint: Footer that answers practical questions first: a 4-column grid of address with a map link, today's hours plus the week, how to pay and what you accept, and who to call out of hours, each at 1rem with headings at 0.875rem small caps; below, legal registration numbers and policies in one line. Max 72rem. Corner radius 0; top rule 2px. Column headings use text-wrap: balance; notes use text-wrap: pretty.
motion: None.
still_check: Any still shows all 4 columns readable.
mobile: At 375px columns stack, hours first.
a11y: footer landmark; address in an address element. Reduced motion: nothing to reduce.
avoid: Newsletter-first footers, social icon walls, or a footer that repeats the menu only.

stack_notes.css: Grid with auto-fit minmax(14rem, 1fr); headings use text-wrap: balance.
stack_notes.js: None required.

name: Features shown in use
blueprint: Features as 4 to 6 short frames of the thing in use, not icons: each frame a 16:10 screen or photo crop at clamp(16rem, 34vw, 28rem) showing the feature doing its job, with a heading at clamp(1.125rem, 2vw, 1.5rem) and text-wrap: balance plus one sentence with text-wrap: pretty. Frames alternate size (large, small, small, large) in a 2-column grid so the row rhythm varies. Corner radius 6px on screen crops (matching the product UI), 0 on photos.
motion: Each frame plays a 3 to 5 second muted loop of the feature once when 60% visible, then rests on its last frame.
still_check: Any still shows every frame's resting state legible.
mobile: At 375px single column; loops replaced by posters until tapped.
a11y: Video has captions or is decorative with the sentence carrying meaning. Reduced motion: posters only.
avoid: Icon grids, three equal columns, or features nobody can see working.

stack_notes.css: Video elements with poster; grid with spans; play via IntersectionObserver.
stack_notes.js: IntersectionObserver play once; pause on exit; disconnect on unmount.

name: Features as answered questions
blueprint: Features expressed as the customer's own questions with the answer as a feature: each item a question at clamp(1.25rem, 2.2vw, 1.75rem) with text-wrap: balance (Can I change the date later?) and a short yes with how (Yes, up to 48 hours before, from your booking page) plus a small screenshot or photo 12rem wide where it helps. Single column, max 46rem, items separated by 3rem space. Corner radius 4px on screenshots.
motion: Entering view, each answer's Yes underlines itself in 250ms.
still_check: Any still shows each question and answer.
mobile: Same at 375px; images move under text.
a11y: Questions are h3. Reduced motion: static.
avoid: Answers that dodge, questions invented to boast, or more than 8 items.

stack_notes.css: Plain flow with @starting-style underline.
stack_notes.js: None required.

name: Years on a ruler
blueprint: Timeline on a true-scale ruler: years spaced in proportion to time (a 2rem tick per year), so busy decades bunch and quiet years stretch. Events hang off the ruler as labelled photos 10rem wide with a date in tabular figures and a heading with text-wrap: balance. The ruler runs horizontally on desktop inside a scroll-snap row with visible progress. Corner radius 0; photos square-cornered.
motion: Vertical scroll in a sticky 220vh container drives the ruler along; the current year marker grows from 1px to 3px as it passes centre.
still_check: Any still shows a readable stretch of years with at least 2 events.
mobile: At 375px the ruler turns vertical and the page scrolls naturally.
a11y: Events are an ol in time order. Reduced motion: vertical list.
avoid: Equal spacing that lies about time, events with no dates, or decorative milestones.

stack_notes.css: Sticky container plus translate on a view() timeline. RTL: the ruler runs from inline-start; reverse translate under :dir(rtl).
stack_notes.js: None required.

name: Line-by-line comparison
blueprint: Comparison of 2 to 3 options as a table of plain statements, one row per question that matters to the buyer (What does it cost per year? What happens if it breaks? Can I cancel?), with each cell a short sentence, not a tick. The option you recommend for whom is noted in the header (Best if you rent). Sticky first column and header. Max 64rem. Corner radius 0; zebra rows at 3% tint. The h2 at clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 2.25rem) with text-wrap: balance; cell sentences use text-wrap: pretty.
motion: Hovering a row highlights it across columns.
still_check: Any still shows every row and option readable.
mobile: At 375px swipe between options with the question column sticky at inline-start.
a11y: A real table with th scope; headers sticky. Reduced motion: no highlight transition.
avoid: Ticks and crosses only, competitor names with negative claims, or hidden rows.

stack_notes.css: position: sticky on th; logical inset-inline-start so RTL keeps the question column at the start.
stack_notes.js: None required.

name: One chart, told plainly
blueprint: Data story built around one honest chart of the brief's own numbers (wait times, harvest yields, call-outs per month, visitors per year): a chart 100% wide and clamp(18rem, 40vh, 28rem) tall, with the takeaway as the h2 at clamp(1.75rem, 3.5vw, 2.75rem), text-wrap: balance, direct labels on the lines (no legend), and a source line under it. Annotations mark 1 to 2 real events on the chart. Corner radius 0; axis lines 1px.
motion: Entering view the line draws from its first point to its last in 900ms; annotations appear when the line reaches them.
still_check: Any still shows the full chart with labels and annotations.
mobile: At 375px the chart becomes 4:5 with fewer ticks.
a11y: Chart has a text summary and a data table toggle. Reduced motion: drawn.
avoid: Truncated axes that exaggerate, 3D charts, or charts of numbers you made up.

stack_notes.css: Inline SVG with stroke-dashoffset on @starting-style; labels as text elements.
stack_notes.js: Optional: draw from data with a small chart helper; no heavy library needed.

name: Numbers as countable objects
blueprint: Data story that shows a number as countable objects of the trade: 1 small icon drawn for the brief's object (a loaf, a tap, a ticket, a seedling) per unit, in rows of 10, so 140 loaves a morning is 14 rows. The h2 at clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 2.25rem), text-wrap: balance, states the number; a second group beside it compares (On a Saturday: 260). Corner radius 0; icons drawn on a 1.25rem grid.
motion: Entering view, rows fill in 40ms apart.
still_check: Any still shows the full objects and the number in text.
mobile: At 375px groups stack; icons 1rem.
a11y: Icon groups aria-hidden; number in text. Reduced motion: filled.
avoid: Generic person icons, numbers too large to count (over 300 — use 1 icon per 10 then), or no comparison.

stack_notes.css: Icons via a repeating background-image in a sized box (width from the count), no hundreds of DOM nodes.
stack_notes.js: None required.

name: Case file per job
blueprint: Selected work as case files: each project a folder-style block with a tab carrying the client type and year, a lead photo at 16:9, then three labelled fields (Brief, What we did, What changed) each 2 to 3 lines with text-wrap: pretty, and one concrete measure in tabular figures. Folders stack with a 1.5rem offset so tabs remain visible. Corner radius 6px on tab tops only, folders square.
motion: As each folder enters view it slides from the stack offset to aligned (300ms), the next folder's tab peeking below.
still_check: Any still shows one full case file and the tabs of the others.
mobile: At 375px folders stack flat with tabs as headings.
a11y: Each folder is an article with h3. Reduced motion: aligned stack.
avoid: Vanity metrics, client logos as proof, or more than 6 cases.

stack_notes.css: position: sticky folders with top offsets per index; logical offsets so RTL mirrors tabs.
stack_notes.js: None required.

name: Where the money went
blueprint: Impact shown as the last year's money in one horizontal bar 100% wide and 3rem tall, split by real proportions into labelled segments (Programmes 71%, Staff 18%, Fundraising 8%, Admin 3%) with direct labels below in tabular figures, and beside each label one example of what that money bought. The h2 at clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 2.25rem), text-wrap: balance. Link to the published accounts. Corner radius 0; segments meet with 2px gaps.
motion: Entering view, segments grow to their widths from inline-start in 600ms.
still_check: Any still shows full bar and labels.
mobile: At 375px labels stack under the bar.
a11y: A table of the same numbers follows the bar for screen readers. Reduced motion: final widths.
avoid: Rounded percentages that do not add to 100, missing admin costs, or pie charts.

stack_notes.css: Flex with flex-basis from custom properties; growth via scaleX with logical transform-origin so RTL grows from inline-start.
stack_notes.js: None required.

name: How to arrive
blueprint: Location written as arrival steps a first-timer needs, each with a small photo 10rem wide: where to park or which stop to use, what the entrance looks like, where to go inside, accessibility route. The h2 at clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 2.25rem), text-wrap: balance, with the address in one line and a map link. Ordered list, max 48rem. Corner radius 2px on photos.
motion: Entering view, steps appear in sequence, 80ms apart.
still_check: Any still shows every step and photo.
mobile: At 375px photos sit above each step.
a11y: An ol; photos have alt describing the landmark. Reduced motion: static.
avoid: An embedded map only, no step-free route, or photos of the logo instead of the door.

stack_notes.css: Plain flow; @starting-style stagger.
stack_notes.js: None required.

name: Walking radius map
blueprint: Location as a simplified drawn map 100% wide and clamp(20rem, 50vh, 32rem) tall with rings at 5, 10 and 15 minutes' walk from the door, nearby landmarks named on the map in the brand type, and a short list of how far real places are (Station 6 minutes, Car park 2 minutes). The h2 at clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 2.25rem), text-wrap: balance. Corner radius 0; rings are 1px dashed.
motion: Entering view, rings expand from the door outward 150ms apart.
still_check: Any still shows map, rings and labels.
mobile: At 375px the list leads and the map follows at 4:5.
a11y: The list carries the same information; map aria-hidden or described. Reduced motion: rings static.
avoid: Satellite screenshots, rings that are not walking time, or a map with no door marked.

stack_notes.css: SVG map with scale transitions on @starting-style.
stack_notes.js: None required.

name: Collapsible sidebar to icon rail
blueprint: App sidebar 16rem wide with grouped nav items 2.5rem tall (icon 1.25rem plus label at 0.9375rem, text-wrap: balance on group headings), that collapses to a 3.5rem icon rail, never to nothing. In the rail every icon keeps a visible tooltip on hover and focus showing its label, the active item keeps its bar marker, group dividers stay, and the collapse toggle stays pinned at block-end. Corner radius 4px on item highlights; rail edge square with a 1px border.
motion: Collapse animates width 16rem to 3.5rem in 200ms while labels fade out by 120ms; tooltips appear after 300ms hover delay, instantly on focus.
still_check: Any still in either state shows icons, the active marker and, in the expanded state, all labels.
mobile: Below 768px the sidebar becomes an off-canvas drawer with labels always shown; the rail state is desktop only.
a11y: Toggle is a button with aria-expanded and aria-controls; collapsed items keep accessible names (aria-label from the label text). Tooltips via popover or anchor with role tooltip. State persisted. Reduced motion: instant width change.
avoid: Collapsing to zero width, icons without labels or tooltips, or a rail that hides the active page.

stack_notes.css: RTL-safe: built only with logical properties (inline-size, inset-inline-start, border-inline-end, padding-inline) so the rail docks at inline-start and the collapse motion and tooltip side mirror automatically under dir=rtl; chevron icon flipped via :dir(rtl).
stack_notes.js: Persist the collapsed state in localStorage with try/catch; tooltips via popover API with anchor positioning, fallback absolute positioning.

name: Directional page slide (RTL-safe)
blueprint: Cross-document page transition where moving forward in the site's order slides the new page in from inline-end and back slides from inline-start, 280ms, with the shared header held still via view-transition-name. Corner radius unchanged; no rounded page cards during the slide.
motion: Forward: old page translates 12% toward inline-start and fades; new page enters from 12% toward inline-end. Back reverses. Header and logo are excluded from the slide.
still_check: Mid-transition stills show the header crisp and both pages legible.
mobile: On phones the slide distance is 8%; same direction rules.
a11y: Reduced motion: crossfade only, 120ms. Focus moves to the new page's h1 after the transition.
avoid: Sliding on every link including in-page anchors, distances over 15%, or blur during the slide.

stack_notes.css: RTL-safe: direction is computed against inline flow; under :root:dir(rtl) the translate signs swap so forward still means toward reading direction. Uses @view-transition { navigation: auto } and view-transition-types forward and back. RTL: mirrored motion direction via :dir(rtl).
stack_notes.js: Set the transition type from the navigation's direction in a pageswap or pagereveal handler based on link order.

name: Reading progress rule
blueprint: A 2px rule fixed under the header that fills with the brand ink as an article is read. Starts at the article's first paragraph and ends at its last, not the page. Corner radius 0.
motion: Width tracks article progress 0-100% via a view() timeline; no easing.
still_check: Any still shows the rule at a sensible fraction.
mobile: Same at phone width.
a11y: aria-hidden decoration. Reduced motion: the rule is static-safe (scroll-linked fill is not animation in time) but hide it if preferred.
avoid: Rules thicker than 3px, gradients, or progress over the full page including footer.

stack_notes.css: scaleX on a fixed element driven by animation-timeline: view() of the article with animation-range: contain. RTL: transform-origin set to inline-start (right under :dir(rtl)) so it fills in reading direction.
stack_notes.js: None required.

name: Button press with real depth
blueprint: Buttons have a 3px bottom edge in a darker tone of their fill; pressing drops the face 2px into the edge for a physical click. Corner radius 4px on the face and edge.
motion: Pointer down: translateY(2px) and edge height 1px, 80ms. Release: back in 140ms.
still_check: Any still shows a button at rest with its edge.
mobile: Same on touch with :active.
a11y: Focus ring 2px outside the face, 3:1 against ground. Reduced motion: colour darken only.
avoid: Bouncy overshoot, edges on text links, or press effects that shift layout.

stack_notes.css: box-shadow 0 3px 0 for the edge; :active transform.
stack_notes.js: None required.

name: Circle reveal from the click
blueprint: Theme or view change that expands a circle from the exact click point to cover the viewport, revealing the new state underneath. Corner radius: the circle is the shape; content keeps its own corners.
motion: clip-path circle from 0 to the farthest corner distance at the pointer coordinates, 450ms ease-out.
still_check: Mid-transition still shows both states cleanly split by the circle edge.
mobile: Same on touch using the tap point.
a11y: Reduced motion: instant swap. Keyboard activation starts the circle from the control's centre.
avoid: Using it for every navigation, durations over 600ms, or revealing text that reflows mid-transition.

stack_notes.css: View transition with ::view-transition-new(root) animated clip-path from --x and --y.
stack_notes.js: Set --x and --y on documentElement from the event, then document.startViewTransition.

name: Header that condenses
blueprint: Sticky header 5rem tall at the top of the page that condenses to 3.5rem after 80px of scroll: logo scales to 0.8, secondary links move into a menu, the main action stays. Corner radius 0; bottom 1px rule appears when condensed.
motion: Height and logo scale animate across the first 80px of scroll via a scroll() timeline; no time-based animation.
still_check: Any still shows a complete header in either state.
mobile: On phones the header is always the condensed state.
a11y: Header landmark; no content hidden that is not reachable through the menu. Reduced motion: switch states without the scrub.
avoid: Hide-on-scroll-down that loses navigation, or condensing so small targets fall under 2.75rem.

stack_notes.css: animation-timeline: scroll(root) with animation-range 0 80px on height and transform.
stack_notes.js: None required.

name: Blur-up image arrival
blueprint: Images arrive from a 24px blurred tiny preview (inlined as a 200-byte data URI or a dominant-colour background) to the sharp image, with the image box sized from the start so nothing shifts. Corner radius as the image's own setting.
motion: On load, blur filter from 12px to 0 and the preview fades in 300ms.
still_check: Stills show either the soft preview or the sharp photo, never an empty box.
mobile: Same on phones.
a11y: Alt present from the start. Reduced motion: swap without blur transition.
avoid: Spinners, layout shift, or blur-up on the LCP hero image (load that one eagerly and sharp).

stack_notes.css: aspect-ratio boxes; background preview; img with a loaded class toggled by the load event or :has(img:not([data-loading])).
stack_notes.js: Small onload handler to remove the blur class.

name: Snap pager with counter
blueprint: Horizontal set of panels with scroll-snap and a counter 03 / 07 in tabular figures plus previous and next buttons 2.75rem square with 2px corners. Panels 85% of the container so the next peeks. Corner radius 2px on panels.
motion: Native scroll with snap; the counter updates as the snapped panel changes; buttons scroll by one panel smoothly.
still_check: Any still shows a full panel and the peek of the next.
mobile: On phones panels are 90%; buttons hidden, swipe primary.
a11y: Region labelled, buttons named, counter in aria-live polite. Reduced motion: scroll-behavior auto.
avoid: Autoplay, hidden scrollbars without other cues, or dots too small to hit.

stack_notes.css: scroll-snap-type: x mandatory; scroll-marker-group where supported for markers. RTL: the scroller follows writing direction; buttons use logical order and arrows flip via :dir(rtl). Pitfall: over-scan each moving layer by its full travel plus a margin so its edges never enter the frame.
stack_notes.js: IntersectionObserver to update the counter; disconnect on unmount.

name: Heading words rise once
blueprint: Section headings that rise word by word out of a line mask the first time they enter view, 40ms per word, 380ms each. Headings stay text-wrap: balance. Corner radius not applicable.
motion: Each word translates from 100% of its line height to 0 inside an overflow clip.
still_check: Any still after entry shows the heading complete; before entry the heading is already visible in the HTML for no-JS and print.
mobile: Same on phones with 25ms stagger.
a11y: Words are spans inside one heading; screen readers read the heading once. Reduced motion: no rise. Text is visible if CSS fails.
avoid: Letter-by-letter splitting, applying to body text, or replaying on every scroll.

stack_notes.css: @starting-style with transition-delay from a --i index per word; view-based trigger via animation-timeline: view() with animation-range entry. Pitfall: measure split or fitted text only after document.fonts.ready, or line breaks shift once the web font lands.
stack_notes.js: Optional: split words server-side to avoid layout shift; no runtime splitter needed.

name: Cursor that says what a click does
blueprint: On fine pointers, hovering a large media item swaps the cursor for a small label 2rem tall with 2px corners saying what clicking will do (Play film, Open menu, See room), following the pointer with a slight lag. Corner radius 2px.
motion: Label follows with a 0.15 lerp per frame; scales from 0.6 to 1 on entering an item in 150ms.
still_check: Stills show the label next to the pointer when over an item, nothing elsewhere.
mobile: No custom cursor on touch; the label text appears as a visible caption under the item instead.
a11y: Real cursor stays visible; the item's accessible name says the same thing. Reduced motion: label snaps to pointer without lag.
avoid: Hiding the system cursor, labels on every link, or labels that say Click.

stack_notes.css: Caption fallback in HTML; label element is aria-hidden.
stack_notes.js: pointermove listener on items only; rAF loop paused when idle; remove listeners on unmount.

name: Field feedback as you go

name: The camp week at a glance

stack_notes.js: None required.

name: Badges they will earn
blueprint: Centred hero: the h1 at clamp(2.5rem, 6vw, 5rem), text-wrap: balance, crossed diagonally by a fabric sash photographed flat, carrying 6 to 8 real embroidered badges for the week's skills (first fire, first website, canoe launch). Each badge 5rem across names its skill on hover and focus. Under it, ages and dates. Corner radius: badges are circles because they are real round patches; buttons 4px.

mobile: At 375px the sash runs horizontally under the h1 and badges are 3.5rem.

stack_notes.css: Fallback: all badges shown; sash photo with absolute badge positions in percentages.
stack_notes.js: Progress mapped to badge index; WAAPI seeked by progress; cleanup on unmount. Pitfall: render each frame as a pure function of progress or time so seeking and scrolling back land on the same state; never chain setTimeout steps.

name: Weeks and places left

Early-drop-off and late-pickup add-ons priced below. The h2 at clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 2.25rem), text-wrap: balance. Corner radius 0 on bars; table ruled.

still_check: Any still shows every week, price and places left in numbers.

a11y: A table with caption; places in text. Reduced motion: static bars.

stack_notes.js: Optional live places fetch; abort on unmount.

name: Who looks after them

The h2 at clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 2.25rem), text-wrap: balance. Max 50rem. Corner radius 4px on portraits.
motion: None beyond a 200ms fade.
still_check: Any still shows ratio, checks and every leader.

a11y: A list of leaders; checks as text with links to the scheme. Reduced motion: no fade.

name: A camp day, by the clock
blueprint: Schedule of one day as a large clock face 22rem across with coloured arcs for each block (drop-off, morning project, lunch, outdoor games, show-and-tell, pickup) and a list beside it with times in tabular figures. The h2 at clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 2.25rem), text-wrap: balance. Corner radius: the clock is a circle; list items square.

stack_notes.js: None required.

name: What to pack
blueprint: FAQ-like packing list parents can tick off on screen or print: grouped items (Every day, Swim days, Do not bring) with checkboxes 1.5rem with 2px corners, each item with a short why. A print button and the parent questions after the list as details. The h2 at clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 2.25rem), text-wrap: balance. Max 44rem. Corner radius 2px on checkboxes.

still_check: Any still shows every item.
mobile: Same at 375px.

avoid: Branded merch on the list, missing do-not-bring rules, or a PDF only.

stack_notes.css: Checkbox :checked strike via pseudo-element; logical origin.
stack_notes.js: Optional localStorage memory of ticks with try/catch.

name: Vintages on the rail
blueprint: Sticky-stage hero for a vineyard, brewery or distillery: a pinned photograph of one bottle (or cask, or growler) at clamp(18rem, 40vw, 30rem) tall, while a rail of vintages or batches scrolls by in a column at inline-end, each year a heading at clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 2.25rem) with text-wrap: balance and a short note on that season (late frost, dry August). The bottle's label swaps to the matching year. The h1 at clamp(2.5rem, 6vw, 5rem) is the first item. Corner radius 0.
motion: Each vintage's view() range crossfades the label photo in 250ms.
still_check: At any vintage midpoint the label matches the year in view.
mobile: At 375px the bottle pins at the top 45svh and years scroll below.
a11y: Years are sections with h2. Reduced motion: no pin; a list of years with label thumbnails.
avoid: Tasting-note purple prose, label swaps out of sync, or vintages that are not real.

stack_notes.css: Named view timelines with timeline-scope on the stage.
stack_notes.js: None required.

name: The glass fills
blueprint: Object-wrap hero: a single glass rendered in WebGL with refraction at clamp(16rem, 34vw, 26rem) tall, standing on the h1 baseline. The h1 at clamp(3rem, 9vw, 8rem), text-wrap: balance, wraps around the glass via shape-outside; as the glass fills, the type behind it bends through the liquid. Under it, cellar door hours. Corner radius 0.
motion: Scroll progress 0-70% fills the glass from empty to two-thirds with a settling surface; 70-100% the surface calms. The pour is driven by progress, not time.
still_check: At 50% the glass is half full and the h1 legible around it.
mobile: At 375px a pre-rendered 3-frame sequence; no refraction.
a11y: Canvas aria-hidden; text in DOM. Reduced motion: full glass still.

stack_notes.css: Fallback: glass photo with shape-outside from its alpha.
stack_notes.js: Shader with refraction of a rendered type texture; dispose on unmount; pause off-screen. Pitfall: render each frame as a pure function of progress or time so seeking and scrolling back land on the same state; never chain setTimeout steps.

name: Tasting flight paddle
blueprint: Menu shown as a wooden tasting paddle seen from above with 4 to 5 glasses in holes, each glass a real photo crop, and under each its name, style, strength and a 3-word note. Flights chosen by tabs (Whites, Reds, House beers). Prices per flight in tabular figures. The h2 at clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 2.25rem), text-wrap: balance. Corner radius 6px on the paddle ends only.
motion: Changing flight slides the glasses out and new ones in, 60ms apart, 250ms each.
still_check: Any still shows one full flight with every label.
mobile: At 375px the paddle turns vertical.
a11y: Tabs pattern; each glass a list item with text. Reduced motion: instant swap.
avoid: Illustrated glasses, notes in jargon, or strengths missing.

stack_notes.css: Radio inputs with :has(); translate entry per glass. RTL: glasses enter from inline-end, mirrored under :dir(rtl).
stack_notes.js: None required.

name: Find the cellar door
blueprint: Location as a drawn estate map 100% wide and clamp(18rem, 45vh, 28rem) tall showing the road in, parking, the cellar door, vines and the walking loop with distances, plus opening hours, booking rules for groups and a designated-driver note. The h2 at clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 2.25rem), text-wrap: balance. Corner radius 0.
motion: Entering view, the road-in route draws from the gate to the door in 800ms.
still_check: Any still shows map, labels and hours.
mobile: At 375px hours lead and the map follows at 4:5.
a11y: Map has a text route description. Reduced motion: drawn route.
avoid: Satellite screenshots, no driver info, or maps without the entrance.

stack_notes.js: None required.

name: From the ground up
blueprint: About section as a soil profile cut: a tall vertical image of the real ground (topsoil, clay, chalk, bedrock) 14rem wide with depth marks in metres, beside a story column with text-wrap: pretty that explains how each layer shapes the drink. The h2 at clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 2.25rem), text-wrap: balance. Corner radius 0.
motion: Scrolling the story highlights the matching layer with a 2px outline.
still_check: Any still shows the profile and story readable.

a11y: Profile aria-hidden; depths in text. Reduced motion: no highlight transition.

name: Do you cover my street?
blueprint: Stacked calm hero for a plumber, electrician or roofer: the h1 at clamp(2rem, 4.5vw, 3.5rem), text-wrap: balance, says the trade and the area (Plumbing across Leeds, same-day where we can), then a postcode field 3.25rem tall with visible label and 4px corners, then 3 plain facts in a row (Fixed call-out 85, Gas Safe 123456, Answering until 22:00) and the phone number as a tap-to-call link. Under it a photo of the van and the actual team member, 3:2. Corner radius 4px on the field and button.
motion: None on load; postcode result appears with a 150ms fade (We cover you, next slot Thursday).
still_check: Any still shows h1, field, facts and phone number.
mobile: At 375px the phone link sits first under the h1.
a11y: Form works without JS; result in a live region; registration numbers link to the registers. Reduced motion: nothing animates.
avoid: Stock hard hats, fake 24/7 claims, or hiding the call-out fee.

stack_notes.css: Plain stacked flow.
stack_notes.js: Optional coverage fetch; abort on unmount.

name: Inside the walls
blueprint: Sticky-stage hero, 260vh: a cutaway drawing of a house (front wall removed) with the trade's systems drawn in colour: pipes and boiler, or wiring and consumer unit, or roof structure and flashing. Chapters in a 26rem column at inline-start each light one part (Boiler, Radiators, Hot water) with the common fault and a fixed price. The h1 at clamp(2.5rem, 6vw, 5rem), text-wrap: balance, is chapter 0. Corner radius 0.
motion: Each chapter's progress range fades other systems to 25% and draws the lit system's lines; rendering is seeked from progress.
still_check: At any chapter midpoint one system is lit and its text readable.
mobile: At 375px the cutaway pins at top 45svh; chapters below.
a11y: Chapters are sections with h2. Reduced motion: no pin, all systems shown with numbered labels.
avoid: Cartoon houses, systems drawn wrong, or prices that change on the phone.

stack_notes.css: Fallback: static cutaway with a numbered legend.
stack_notes.js: Progress from a scroll listener throttled to rAF; set path dash offsets; cleanup on unmount. Pitfall: render each frame as a pure function of progress or time so seeking and scrolling back land on the same state; never chain setTimeout steps.

name: Fixed prices for common jobs
blueprint: Pricing as a list of common jobs at fixed prices (Replace a tap 120, Boiler service 95, Unblock a sink 85), each with what is included, typical time on site, and when it costs more, in tabular figures, plus the hourly rate for everything else. The h2 at clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 2.25rem), text-wrap: balance. Max 52rem. Corner radius 0; ruled rows.

The h2 at clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 2.25rem), text-wrap: balance. Max 50rem. Corner radius 2px on photos.
motion: None beyond a 200ms fade on new entries.
still_check: Any still shows every entry.

name: What is it doing?
blueprint: Services entered by symptom: a grid of 6 to 8 plain-language symptoms (No hot water, Lights tripping, Damp patch on ceiling, Dripping tap) as buttons 3.5rem tall with 4px corners; choosing one shows the likely causes, whether it is urgent, what you can safely check yourself and the service with its price. The h2 at clamp(1.75rem, 3.5vw, 2.75rem), text-wrap: balance. Corner radius 4px on buttons.

name: Newspaper masthead nav

stack_notes.js: None required.

name: Command palette with a visible door
blueprint: Navigation whose primary route is a command palette, but with a visible door: a search-like trigger 2.5rem tall and 18rem wide with 4px corners in the header showing Search or jump to with the shortcut (Ctrl K or Cmd K by platform), plus 2 to 3 always-visible links for the top destinations. The palette opens as a centred dialog 40rem wide with grouped results (Pages, Actions, Recent), each row 2.5rem with icon, label and shortcut hint. Headings use text-wrap: balance. Corner radius 6px on the dialog, 4px on rows.

still_check: Any still shows the trigger with its shortcut hint visible.

avoid: Hiding all navigation behind a shortcut nobody knows, shortcut hints that are wrong for the platform. Avoid the default fingerprint: wordmark at one end, 4 to 5 centred links, a button at the other end.

stack_notes.css: dialog with @starting-style; trigger layout via logical properties.
stack_notes.js: Fuzzy match on a static index; keydown listener on document removed on unmount.

name: Numbered index overlay
blueprint: A menu button opens a full-screen index: each destination as a numbered line at clamp(2rem, 6vw, 4.5rem) with text-wrap: balance, its number in tabular figures at inline-start and a one-line description at inline-end; hovering or focusing a line shows a preview image 24rem wide pinned at block-end inline-end. avoid: Overlays with only 3 items, preview images as the only labels. Avoid the default fingerprint: wordmark at one end, 4 to 5 centred links, a button at the other end.

name: Thumb dock on phones, bar on desktop
blueprint: Below 48rem: a dock fixed 0.75rem above block-end (plus safe-area inset), full width minus 1rem gutters, 4 destinations plus Menu as icon-and-label pairs, each 3.5rem tall with labels at 0.75rem always visible, 6px corners on the dock, the current item with a solid fill. A slim top bar keeps the name and a skip link. At 48rem and up: no dock; a standard single-row header 4rem tall with wordmark, the same destinations at 0.9375rem and the primary action as a button 2.5rem tall with 4px corners. States: item hover (tint 6%), current (fill), pressed (scale 0.97 for 100ms), focus (2px ring offset 2px).
motion: On phones the dock slides down out of view after 200px of continuous downward scroll and returns on any upward scroll or focus within, 180ms ease-out. Desktop header does not move.
still_check: Any still shows the dock with labels.
mobile: At 375px labels stay visible under icons (never icon-only).
a11y: nav landmark placed early in DOM; aria-current on the active item; the dock never hides while it contains focus. Reduced motion: dock never hides. Safe-area insets respected.
avoid: A floating dock on desktop, icon-only items, a dock covering cart or consent controls, hiding on every small scroll, or more than 5 items.

stack_notes.css: position: fixed with inset-block-end: max(1rem, env(safe-area-inset-bottom)); logical inline centring.
stack_notes.js: Scroll direction listener with a 200px threshold; passive listener removed on unmount.

name: Divider tabs down the edge
blueprint: Section navigation as file-divider tabs standing out from the content's inline-start edge, one per main section, each tab 2.5rem wide and clamp(6rem, 12vh, 9rem) tall with its label set vertically at 0.9375rem. The active tab is flush with the page paper; others step back 0.25rem in a darker tone. A short top bar holds only the name and contact. Labels use text-wrap: balance where horizontal. still_check: Any still shows all tabs readable and one active.
mobile: At 375px tabs become a horizontal tab row under the top bar with scroll-snap.
a11y: nav with list of links; vertical labels are real text with writing-mode; aria-current on the active tab. Reduced motion: no slide.
avoid: Rotated text that is too small, more than 7 tabs. Avoid the default fingerprint: wordmark at one end, 4 to 5 centred links, a button at the other end.

stack_notes.css: RTL-safe: writing-mode vertical-rl labels, tabs docked with inset-inline-start and border-start-start-radius so the rail and its step motion mirror automatically under dir=rtl.
stack_notes.js: None required.

name: Breadcrumb with siblings
blueprint: Wayfinding bar under the header for deep sites: a breadcrumb trail at 0.9375rem where every crumb but the current opens a small menu of its siblings, so a visitor on Bins > Garden waste can jump to Bins > Bulky items without going back. Current page in bold. Height 2.75rem; menus max 18rem wide. Crumb labels use text-wrap: balance in menus. Corner radius 4px on sibling menus, 0 on the bar.

still_check: Any still shows the full trail.

avoid: Breadcrumbs that duplicate the main nav, separators read aloud, or crumbs that are not links. Avoid the default fingerprint: wordmark at one end, 4 to 5 centred links, a button at the other end.

name: Floating island that names the section
blueprint: After the hero, the full header collapses into a floating island 3rem tall at block-start centre that shows the current section's name and a menu button; opening it expands the island into a 28rem panel listing all sections with the current one marked. stack_notes.js: IntersectionObserver for the active section; document.startViewTransition for expand; disconnect on unmount. Pitfall: over-scan each moving layer by its full travel plus a margin so its edges never enter the frame.

name: Navigation as a prompt
blueprint: A one-line prompt in the header styled like the tool's own CLI, 3rem tall in monospace at 0.9375rem: a prompt glyph then a typed path such as docs/getting-started; typing completes against real routes with a suggestion list 32rem wide, and Tab completes as in a shell. avoid: Fake terminals that do nothing, blinking when unfocused, or hiding all links in the prompt. Avoid the default fingerprint: wordmark at one end, 4 to 5 centred links, a button at the other end.

stack_notes.js: Route index loaded once; key handling scoped to the input; cleanup on unmount.

name: Menu by who you are

name: In-page section progress strip
blueprint: For long pages: a sticky strip 2.75rem tall under the header with each section as a segment whose width matches its length, labelled with a short name at 0.8125rem, and a fill line 2px tall showing reading progress inside the current segment. Labels use text-wrap: balance. Corner radius 0; segments separated by 1px gaps.
motion: Fill tracks scroll progress through each section via view() timelines.
still_check: Any still shows segment names and a filled position.
mobile: At 375px it shows only the current section name and a compact progress line with a Sections button.
a11y: nav with links to section ids; aria-current on the active section. Reduced motion: progress fill still tracks scroll (not time) but transitions are removed.
avoid: Strips on short pages, labels too small to tap, or progress that includes the footer. Avoid the default fingerprint: wordmark at one end, 4 to 5 centred links, a button at the other end.

stack_notes.css: Named view timelines with timeline-scope; fills grow from inline-start with logical transform-origin so RTL mirrors.
stack_notes.js: None required.

name: Open-now nav bar
blueprint: A slim top bar 2.5rem tall above the main nav that always tells the truth about now: Open now until 18:00 or Closed, opens 08:00 tomorrow, plus the phone number and the address as a map link. The main nav below has the name and up to 4 links. Status text uses text-wrap: balance. Corner radius 0; status dot 0.5rem.
motion: Status updates on the minute without movement.
still_check: Any still shows status, phone and address.
mobile: At 375px status and a call button share the bar; the address moves into the menu.
a11y: Status in text, not colour only; tel: link; time zone of the business. Reduced motion: nothing animates.
avoid: Wrong hours after holidays (needs exceptions data), or a bar that duplicates the hero. Avoid the default fingerprint: wordmark at one end, 4 to 5 centred links, a button at the other end.

stack_notes.css: Server-rendered status with a small script refresh.
stack_notes.js: Recompute each minute; clear interval on unmount.

name: Bilingual nav that mirrors
blueprint: Navigation for sites in two scripts (Arabic and English, Hebrew and English, Urdu and English): the language switch shows each language in its own script, and switching mirrors the whole bar so the name sits at inline-start in either direction. Links use the language's own word lengths, so the bar is designed with 30% spare width. Labels use text-wrap: balance. Corner radius 4px on the switch's focus state only.
motion: On language change, a cross-document transition slides in the reading direction of the new language, 240ms.
still_check: Any still shows the bar correctly mirrored for its language.
mobile: At 375px links move into a drawer that opens from inline-start of the current direction.
a11y: lang and dir set on html; switch links use hreflang and lang attributes. Keyboard order follows visual order in both directions. Reduced motion: no slide.
avoid: Flags for languages, hard-coded margin-left, or icons that do not flip (arrows, chevrons). Avoid the default fingerprint: wordmark at one end, 4 to 5 centred links, a button at the other end.

stack_notes.css: RTL-safe: only logical properties (margin-inline, padding-inline, inset-inline-start); directional icons flipped with :dir(rtl) scaleX(-1); slide direction mirrored under :dir(rtl).
stack_notes.js: Persist the language choice only by URL, not storage.

name: Footer that closes like a letter
blueprint: Footer written as the end of a letter: a 2 to 3 sentence closing with text-wrap: pretty at clamp(1.125rem, 2vw, 1.375rem) in a reading serif, signed by a real person with their role and direct line, then a short PS with the one practical thing people forget (We are closed bank holidays). Legal line under a hairline. Max 40rem at inline-start. Corner radius 0.
motion: None.
still_check: Any still shows the letter, signature, PS and legal line.
mobile: Same at 375px.
a11y: footer landmark; signature is text, not only an image. Keyboard: links in reading order. Reduced motion: nothing to reduce.
avoid: Fake warmth with no contact detail, signatures in a script font. Avoid the default fingerprint: 4 link columns plus a row of social icons.

stack_notes.css: Plain flow; logical alignment.
stack_notes.js: None required.

name: Dense typographic index footer
blueprint: Footer as an alphabetical index of every page, set dense in 2 to 4 text columns at 0.875rem with letter headings at 1.25rem (A: About us, Accessibility, Annual report; B: Bins, Book a visit), so people scanning for one thing find it in seconds. Headings use text-wrap: balance. The address and phone sit in a single strong line above the index. Corner radius 0.
motion: None.
still_check: Any still shows the index readable.
mobile: At 375px letters become a jump row and the index a single column.
a11y: nav aria-label Site index; letter headings are h2 or h3. Keyboard: jump row links to letters. Reduced motion: nothing to reduce.
avoid: Indexes with duplicates, dead links, or tiny 11px type. Avoid the default fingerprint: 4 link columns plus a row of social icons.

stack_notes.css: CSS columns with break-inside: avoid on letter groups.
stack_notes.js: Generate from the sitemap at build time.

name: Statement footer
blueprint: Footer that ends on one statement at clamp(2.5rem, 8vw, 7rem) with text-wrap: balance, the studio's actual position in a sentence, and under it a single contact route (an email address set as large as the statement's second line) and a short line of legal links. Nothing else. Corner radius 0.
motion: Statement words fill from muted to full ink as the footer enters (view() timeline, no time animation).
still_check: Any still shows the statement and the contact route readable.
mobile: At 375px the statement at clamp(2rem, 11vw, 3rem).
a11y: footer landmark; email is a real mailto link. Reduced motion: full ink.
avoid: Statements that are slogans, giant type with no contact, or marquee footers. Avoid the default fingerprint: 4 link columns plus a row of social icons.

stack_notes.css: background-clip text fill on a view() timeline.
stack_notes.js: None required.

name: Map band footer
blueprint: Footer opening with a drawn street map band 100% wide and clamp(12rem, 25vh, 18rem) tall centred on the door, with the address, hours and phone set on a solid block at inline-start over the band's quiet area, then one line of policies. Headings use text-wrap: balance. Corner radius 0 on the block.
motion: Map pans 3% toward the door as the footer enters view.
still_check: Any still shows the map, block text and policies.
mobile: At 375px the block sits above the map.
a11y: Map aria-hidden; address in an address element with a directions link. Reduced motion: no pan.
avoid: Embedded live maps loading on every page, maps with no door marked. Avoid the default fingerprint: 4 link columns plus a row of social icons.

stack_notes.css: Static SVG or image map; pan via view() timeline; over-scan the map by the pan distance. Pitfall: over-scan each moving layer by its full travel plus a margin so its edges never enter the frame.
stack_notes.js: None required.

name: Sitemap written as sentences
blueprint: Footer that writes the sitemap as 3 to 4 short sentences with the links inline: Come and see us at the shop, book a table online, or read about our flour. Planning an event? See the private room and catering prices. Set at clamp(1.125rem, 2vw, 1.5rem) with text-wrap: pretty, max 44rem, legal line below. Corner radius 0; links underlined.
motion: Link underlines thicken on hover in 120ms.
still_check: Any still shows every sentence and link.
mobile: Same at 375px.
a11y: footer with a nav aria-label; links have meaningful text. Reduced motion: no transition.
avoid: Sentences longer than 25 words, links hidden in run-on prose. Avoid the default fingerprint: 4 link columns plus a row of social icons.

stack_notes.css: Plain flow; text-decoration-thickness transition.
stack_notes.js: None required.

name: Footer that loops to the start
blueprint: Footer whose last band, 100vh tall, shows the top of the page again (the hero h1 at the same clamp(3rem, 9vw, 8rem), text-wrap: balance) so scrolling past the end returns to the start; above it, the contact block and legal links. A Back to top link is always present for keyboard users. Corner radius 0.
motion: When the band fills the viewport, the scroll position resets to the top seamlessly; scrolling up from the band does nothing special.
still_check: Any still shows the contact block or the hero copy complete.
mobile: At 375px the loop is disabled; the band becomes a Back to top link.
a11y: Loop only for pointer users; never traps keyboard or screen-reader users; footer content reachable by Tab. Reduced motion: no loop.
avoid: Loops that hide the footer content, or loops on sites with forms. Avoid the default fingerprint: 4 link columns plus a row of social icons.

stack_notes.css: Fallback: plain band with a Back to top link.
stack_notes.js: IntersectionObserver on the band; scrollTo top without smooth behaviour; disconnect on unmount. Pitfall: render each frame as a pure function of progress or time so seeking and scrolling back land on the same state; never chain setTimeout steps.

name: Hanging numeral head
blueprint: Section heading with its number hanging in the inline-start margin outside the text column: the numeral at clamp(2.5rem, 5vw, 4rem) in tabular figures and a light weight, the h2 at clamp(1.75rem, 3.5vw, 2.75rem) with text-wrap: balance aligned to the column edge. Corner radius 0.
motion: None.
still_check: Any still shows numeral and heading aligned.
mobile: At 375px the numeral sits above the heading at clamp(1.5rem, 8vw, 2rem).
a11y: Numerals are aria-hidden or part of the heading text as 02. Reduced motion: nothing to reduce.
avoid: Numbers on sections that have no order, or numerals larger than the heading's meaning.

stack_notes.css: Negative margin-inline-start equal to the numeral column so RTL hangs into the other margin automatically.
stack_notes.js: None required.

name: Sticky section label
blueprint: Section label that stays pinned at block-start inline-start of its section while the content scrolls beside it: label at 0.875rem small caps, the h2 at clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 2.25rem) with text-wrap: balance, in a 14rem column. The next section's label pushes it out. Corner radius 0.
motion: Sticky positioning only; no animation.
still_check: Any still shows one label pinned alongside its content.
mobile: At 375px the label sits above the content and does not stick.
a11y: Real h2 in order. Reduced motion: nothing to reduce.
avoid: Sticky labels on short sections, or labels covering content.

stack_notes.css: position: sticky with inset-block-start; logical column placement.
stack_notes.js: None required.

name: Run-in heading
blueprint: Heading that runs into its first paragraph on the same line: the h2 in bold small caps at the paragraph's size plus 0.125rem, followed by a full stop and the text continuing, so dense sections read like a well-set report. Body at 1.0625rem with text-wrap: pretty. Corner radius 0.
motion: None.
still_check: Any still shows heading and paragraph on one line.
mobile: Same at 375px.
a11y: The heading is still a real h2 (display: inline). Reduced motion: nothing to reduce.
avoid: Run-ins on marketing pages that need scanning, or headings longer than 6 words.

stack_notes.css: h2 { display: inline } followed by an inline p via display: contents wrapper.
stack_notes.js: None required.

name: Heading under the picture
blueprint: Section head placed after its lead image instead of before it: a full-width photo 21:9, and directly beneath, the h2 at clamp(2rem, 5vw, 4rem) with text-wrap: balance, set tight to the image's bottom edge as a caption-title. Corner radius 0.
motion: Image settles 1.04 to 1 as it enters view.
still_check: Any still shows image and heading touching.
mobile: At 375px image 4:3.
a11y: Heading precedes the image in DOM order for screen readers (visual order via grid). Reduced motion: no settle.
avoid: Images with no relation to the section, heading floating mid-image.

stack_notes.css: Grid with order or grid-row to place the image first visually while the h2 comes first in source.
stack_notes.js: None required.

name: Ruled head with a count
blueprint: A full-width 1px rule with the h2 at clamp(1.25rem, 2.5vw, 1.75rem) and text-wrap: balance at inline-start and a real count at inline-end in tabular figures (14 rooms, 6 vacancies, 3 services this week). Corner radius 0.
motion: Count ticks to its value on entry in 400ms.
still_check: Any still shows rule, heading and count.
mobile: Same at 375px.
a11y: Count is text inside the heading or adjacent with aria-describedby. Reduced motion: no tick.
avoid: Counts that are vanity numbers or never update.

stack_notes.css: Flex with justify-content space-between; logical so RTL swaps sides.
stack_notes.js: None required.

name: Heading with the object inline
blueprint: The h2 at clamp(2rem, 5vw, 4rem) with text-wrap: balance carries a small cut-out photo of the section's real object set inline at cap height (a loaf between words in Our bread, a key in Rooms), 1.1em tall. Corner radius 0; the object has no frame.
motion: Object rotates 6deg once as the heading enters view.
still_check: Any still shows heading and object aligned to the text.
mobile: Same at 375px; object stays at 1.1em.
a11y: Object img has empty alt or a word it replaces. Reduced motion: no rotate.
avoid: Emoji in place of photos, objects in every heading on the page.

stack_notes.css: img with height 1.1em and vertical-align: -0.15em.
stack_notes.js: None required.

name: Heading with its lede beside it
blueprint: Two-part head: the h2 at clamp(1.75rem, 4vw, 3rem) with text-wrap: balance on the inline-start 5 columns and a 2 to 3 sentence lede at 1.125rem with text-wrap: pretty on the inline-end 5 columns, both top-aligned, separated by a 1px vertical rule. Corner radius 0.
motion: None.
still_check: Any still shows both parts.
mobile: At 375px the lede follows the heading.
a11y: Heading first in DOM. Reduced motion: nothing to reduce.
avoid: Ledes that repeat the heading, rules heavier than text.

stack_notes.css: Grid with logical columns.
stack_notes.js: None required.

name: Heading as the visitor's question
blueprint: Section head phrased as the question a visitor would type (How long does a repair take?), the h2 at clamp(1.75rem, 4vw, 3rem) with text-wrap: balance, answered directly beneath by one plain sentence at clamp(1.125rem, 1.6vw, 1.375rem) with text-wrap: pretty in the full ink and a heavier weight, max 36rem, before any detail. Question and answer share one text column; the gap between them is 0.75rem, the gap to the section body 2.5rem. Corner radius 0; no bars, icons or boxes.
motion: None.
still_check: Any still shows question and answer together.
mobile: Same at 375px.
a11y: The question is the h2; the answer is the first paragraph. Reduced motion: bar shown full.
avoid: Accent bars, quote icons, Q and A labels, answers that dodge the question, or questions written in marketing voice.

stack_notes.css: Border-inline-start bar via a pseudo-element with a view() timeline.
stack_notes.js: None required.

name: Reviews with their source
blueprint: Real review excerpts pulled from a named public platform, each with the platform, the date, the rating as a number and a link to the original, laid as a single column of 4 to 6 short excerpts (max 40 words) with text-wrap: pretty, plus the overall average and count from the same source. Max 44rem. Corner radius 0; no quote-mark graphics.
motion: None.
still_check: Any still shows every excerpt with source and date.
mobile: Same at 375px.
a11y: Each excerpt a blockquote with cite URL. Reduced motion: nothing to reduce.
avoid: Invented testimonials, excerpts cut to change meaning, or averages from an unnamed source.

stack_notes.css: Plain flow.
stack_notes.js: Fetch at build time from the platform API where allowed.

name: Press clippings, scanned
blueprint: Press coverage shown as scanned clippings of the actual articles at their real proportions, 14rem to 22rem wide, slightly rotated (-1 to 1deg) on a pale ground, each with the publication, date and a link to read it. Headings use text-wrap: balance. Corner radius 0.
motion: Hover straightens and lifts a clipping 4px.
still_check: Any still shows each clipping with source and date legible.
mobile: At 375px clippings stack without rotation.
a11y: Clippings are links with the headline as text. Reduced motion: no lift.
avoid: Logo walls of outlets, clippings that cannot be read, or As seen in claims.

stack_notes.css: Grid with small rotations from custom properties.
stack_notes.js: None required.

name: Measured response times
blueprint: Proof as a histogram of real measured response or turnaround times over the last 90 days (minutes to answer, hours to arrive, days to deliver), with the median as a big number at clamp(2.5rem, 6vw, 4.5rem) in tabular figures and the slowest 5% stated honestly. The h2 at clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 2.25rem), text-wrap: balance. Corner radius 0 on bars.
motion: Bars grow on entry 30ms apart.
still_check: Any still shows the histogram, median and slow tail.
mobile: At 375px bins are grouped in 5s.
a11y: A table of the bins follows. Reduced motion: grown bars.
avoid: Averages without distribution, cherry-picked windows, or no date range.

stack_notes.css: CSS grid bars with heights from custom properties.
stack_notes.js: None required.

name: Certificates you can verify
blueprint: Licences and certificates shown as scans 10rem wide at real proportions, each with holder, number, expiry date and a Verify link to the issuing body, in a 3 to 4 column grid. Expired items never shown. The h2 at clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 2.25rem), text-wrap: balance. Corner radius 0; scans have a 1px border.
motion: None.
still_check: Any still shows each scan with number and expiry.
mobile: At 375px 2 columns; details under each scan.
a11y: Numbers and expiry dates as text. Reduced motion: nothing to reduce.
avoid: Badge icons in place of real documents, or expired certificates.

stack_notes.css: Grid with auto-fit.
stack_notes.js: None required.

name: How many come back
blueprint: Proof stated as one honest retention fact with its method: 62% of last year's customers booked again within 12 months, set at clamp(2rem, 5vw, 3.5rem) with text-wrap: balance, then a one-paragraph method note (how counted, which period) with text-wrap: pretty, and 3 anonymised return stories as single lines (Fourth kitchen we have fitted for one family). Corner radius 0.
motion: None.
still_check: Any still shows the figure, method and lines.
mobile: Same at 375px.
a11y: Plain text. Reduced motion: nothing to reduce.
avoid: Numbers without method, invented stories, or rounding up.

stack_notes.css: Plain flow.
stack_notes.js: None required.

name: Form written as a sentence
blueprint: Call to action as a sentence with inline fields: I need [a plumber v] in [postcode] on [date], set at clamp(1.5rem, 3.5vw, 2.5rem) with text-wrap: balance, fields underlined and sized to their content, and a submit button 3rem tall with 4px corners at the sentence end. Corner radius 4px on the button; fields have no box.
motion: Fields widen to fit typed text; submit arrow nudges toward inline-end on hover.
still_check: Any still shows the full sentence with fields.
mobile: At 375px each field breaks to its own line within the sentence.
a11y: Each field has a visible or visually hidden label that reads in sentence order; errors announced. Reduced motion: no nudge.
avoid: Sentences longer than 3 fields, or select menus with jokes.

stack_notes.css: field-sizing: content where supported; logical nudge direction flips under :dir(rtl). Pitfall: measure split or fitted text only after document.fonts.ready, or line breaks shift once the web font lands.
stack_notes.js: None required.

name: Sticky action bar
blueprint: A slim bar fixed at block-end on phones and tablets with the two real actions (Call, Book) side by side, each 3.25rem tall with 4px corners, appearing after the hero and hiding when the footer contact block is in view so the same actions are never shown twice. Labels use text-wrap: balance. Corner radius 4px on buttons; bar square.
motion: Bar slides up 3.5rem in 200ms when shown and down when the footer arrives.
still_check: Any still shows either the bar complete or no bar.
mobile: Shown only below 64rem; desktop uses the header actions.
a11y: Bar is a region with a label; safe-area inset respected; never covers focused elements. Reduced motion: instant show and hide.
avoid: Bars with 4 buttons, bars that cover cookie choices, or bars on every viewport.

stack_notes.css: position: fixed; show and hide via scroll-driven animation ranges on the hero and footer.
stack_notes.js: Optional IntersectionObserver fallback; disconnect on unmount.

name: Typographic link CTA
blueprint: Closing CTA as one large link sentence at clamp(2.5rem, 7vw, 6rem) with text-wrap: balance (Start a project with us), underlined with a 3px line, and a drawn arrow glyph at its end. A small line under it says what happens after the click. Corner radius 0; no button box.
motion: Hover thickens the underline to 6px and slides the arrow 0.5rem toward inline-end in 200ms.
still_check: Any still shows the full link and the following line.
mobile: At 375px clamp(2rem, 10vw, 3rem).
a11y: One link with full text as its name; focus ring offset 4px. Reduced motion: thickness change only.
avoid: Arrows on every link, vague link text (Let us talk), or several big links in a row.

stack_notes.css: text-decoration-thickness transition; arrow translate flipped under :dir(rtl).
stack_notes.js: None required.

name: Today's service status board
blueprint: First screen is today's status for every public service, one row each at 1.0625rem: service name, a status word (Running, Delayed, Closed), the reason in plain words and when it was last checked, in tabular figures. The h1 above at clamp(1.75rem, 4vw, 3rem) with text-wrap: balance states the date. Rows 3.25rem tall with 1px hairlines; corner radius 0.
motion: None; rows update in place when the status feed changes.
still_check: Any still shows every service, its status word and the check time.
mobile: At 375px reason text wraps under the status word.
a11y: A table with a caption; status in words, not colour alone. Reduced motion: nothing animates.
avoid: Status dots without words, green ticks on every row by default, stale timestamps.

stack_notes.css: Plain table; status tones from colour tokens.
stack_notes.js: Poll the status feed every 5 minutes; stop polling when the tab is hidden.

name: Your street on the ward map
blueprint: A quiet drawn map of the district fills the first screen in two muted tones, with ward boundaries as 1px lines and a single postcode field 3rem tall with 4px corners laid over its emptiest area. Entering a postcode marks the street and lists its bin day, nearest library and councillor. The h1 at clamp(2rem, 5vw, 3.75rem) with text-wrap: balance reads Everything for your street. Corner radius 4px on the field and result card.
motion: The result card fades in 150ms; the map does not move.
still_check: Any still shows the map, the field and the heading.
mobile: At 375px the field sits above a cropped map 16rem tall.
a11y: Map aria-hidden; the field has a label and errors in text; results are a list with headings. Reduced motion: no fade.
avoid: Interactive slippy maps for a postcode lookup, maps that block the field.

stack_notes.css: Static SVG map; result card positioned inside a relative wrapper.
stack_notes.js: Lookup against a postcode table; no third-party map calls.

name: One plain public notice
blueprint: When there is something the public must know, the first screen is that notice set as a poster: the message at clamp(2.25rem, 7vw, 5.5rem) with text-wrap: balance (Tap water in Riverside is safe to drink again), then issued by, issued at, what to do and where to read more, each a labelled line at 1.0625rem. Plain sans, flat ground, 2px rule frame. Corner radius 0.
motion: None.
still_check: Any still shows the notice, its date and what to do.
mobile: At 375px the message at clamp(1.75rem, 9vw, 2.5rem).
a11y: The notice is the h1; labelled lines as a dl. Reduced motion: nothing animates.
avoid: Notices with no issue time, marketing copy in the notice slot, notices left up after they expire.

stack_notes.css: Grid poster with a solid frame from border tokens.
stack_notes.js: Expire the notice server side at its end time.

name: One light in a dark room
blueprint: A deep, nearly black ground with one real photograph of a lit candle 18rem wide at the centre, its warm light the only accent on the page. Under it the h1 at clamp(1.75rem, 4vw, 3rem) with text-wrap: balance (We are here, day and night), the 24-hour phone line in tabular figures at 1.5rem, and a link to today's services. Corner radius 0; photo unframed.
motion: None.
still_check: Any still shows the candle, the heading and the phone number.
mobile: At 375px the photo is 12rem wide.
a11y: Phone is a tel: link; candle image alt describes it plainly. Contrast of all text on the dark ground at least 7:1. Reduced motion: nothing animates.
avoid: Flickering animated flames, stock lilies, script fonts.

stack_notes.css: Dark ground and accent from colour tokens, never hard-coded.
stack_notes.js: None required.

name: Funeral notices column
blueprint: The first screen is the notices column as a good newspaper sets it: the h1 Funeral notices at clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 2.25rem) with text-wrap: balance, then this week's services as entries at 1.0625rem with text-wrap: pretty, each with the full name in small caps, dates of life, service time and place, and a link to the family's notice. Single column 38rem wide between hairlines. Corner radius 0.
motion: None.
still_check: Any still shows each notice complete.
mobile: Same at 375px.
a11y: Entries are articles with h2 names. Reduced motion: nothing animates.
avoid: Photo grids of the deceased by default, notices without the family's consent.

stack_notes.css: Plain flow with hairline borders.
stack_notes.js: None required.

name: What to do first
blueprint: For someone whose relative has just died: a real photograph of the funeral home's own quiet front room as the back layer at 40% tone, and over it a solid panel 32rem wide with the h1 at clamp(1.75rem, 4vw, 2.75rem) with text-wrap: balance (Someone has died. Here is what happens next) and 3 numbered steps in plain words with the 24-hour number first. Corner radius 4px on the panel.
motion: None.
still_check: Any still shows the panel, steps and phone number.
mobile: At 375px the photo becomes a 12rem band above the panel.
a11y: Steps as an ordered list; phone as tel:. Reduced motion: nothing animates.
avoid: Sales language, packages before the steps, or hiding the phone number.

stack_notes.css: Panel in a relative wrapper over the photo; tones from tokens. Pitfall: give the overlay stack an explicit positioning context (a shared grid cell or position: relative parent) so layers align at every size.
stack_notes.js: None required.

name: The statement, made readable
blueprint: The first screen shows a real customer statement page reset in a reading serif at 1.0625rem with text-wrap: pretty: balance, money in, money out, fees in plain words, beside the h1 at clamp(2rem, 5vw, 3.75rem) with text-wrap: balance (Your statement, in sentences). The page sits on a pale ground 28rem wide with a soft shadow. Corner radius 2px on the page.
motion: None.
still_check: Any still shows the page legible and the heading.
mobile: At 375px the page sits under the heading at full width.
a11y: Statement content is real text with headings. Reduced motion: nothing animates.
avoid: Blurred fake statements, fees in small print.

stack_notes.css: Grid poster; page shadow from tokens.
stack_notes.js: None required.

name: This rate and every change to it
blueprint: The current savings or lending rate at clamp(3rem, 9vw, 7rem) in tabular figures with text-wrap: balance on its label, and beneath it a step chart 100% wide and 10rem tall drawing every change over the last 24 months with each step dated, so the history is not hidden. A link to the full rate sheet. Corner radius 0; steps drawn with 2px lines.
motion: None.
still_check: Any still shows the rate, the step chart and its dates.
mobile: At 375px the chart covers 12 months with a link to the rest.
a11y: A table of changes follows the chart; the chart is aria-hidden. Reduced motion: nothing animates.
avoid: Teaser rates without conditions, charts with no dates or source.

stack_notes.css: Inline SVG step path from data; line colour from tokens.
stack_notes.js: Render the chart at build time from the published rate history.

name: Savings that stack as you set them
blueprint: A drawn stack of coins on a dark ground at block-end grows as the visitor sets a monthly amount and a number of years with two sliders 3rem tall; the total at clamp(2.5rem, 7vw, 5rem) in tabular figures updates from a real compound-interest calculation at today's rate, stated beside it. The h1 at clamp(1.75rem, 4vw, 3rem) with text-wrap: balance. Corner radius 4px on slider thumbs.
motion: Coins add one by one as the total grows, 20ms apart, derived from the current value rather than timers.
still_check: Any still shows the stack, sliders and total for the current settings.
