avoid: A search field without a submit path, totals that disagree with the basket page, or a chips row that hides content under a sticky header. Avoid the default fingerprint: wordmark left, centred links, button right.

stack_notes.css: Grid with grid-template-columns: auto 1fr auto auto; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums on the total; chips row overflow-x: auto with scroll-snap-type.
stack_notes.js: A scroll direction listener throttled with requestAnimationFrame toggles a class; remove the listener on unmount.

name: Edge spine nav
blueprint: A fixed vertical spine 4rem wide on the left edge, full viewport height. The wordmark is set rotated to read bottom to top at clamp(1.25rem, 2vw, 1.75rem); links stack below it as short rotated labels with 1.5rem gaps. Page content gets a 4rem left margin. A 1px rule separates spine from page.
motion: The current section label gains the accent and a 2px tick that slides to it over 240ms as sections enter. Nothing else moves.
still_check: Any still shows the rotated wordmark, every link label and the tick on the current one.
mobile: At 375px the spine becomes a 3.5rem top bar with horizontal labels; the tick turns into an underline. Targets at least 44px.
a11y: Rotated text keeps its reading order in the DOM; links are a list inside nav. aria-current marks the section. Reduced motion jumps the tick.
avoid: Rotated labels too long to fit, the spine covering content on narrow tablets, or low-contrast small rotated text. Avoid the default fingerprint: wordmark left, centred links, button right.

stack_notes.css: writing-mode: vertical-rl with transform: rotate(180deg); position: fixed; inset-block: 0; scroll-margin on sections.
stack_notes.js: IntersectionObserver marks the current section; disconnect it on unmount.

name: Corner index nav
blueprint: No bar. The wordmark sits in the top-left corner and a small Index control in the top-right corner, both at clamp(0.9rem, 1.2vw, 1rem) with 1.5rem inset on a small backing chip. Index opens a panel from the right edge, width min(26rem, 90vw), listing every page as numbered lines with one-line descriptions. The hero gets the whole first screen.
motion: The panel slides in over 280ms with an ease-out and its lines fade in 30ms apart; Escape or the close control slides it back.
still_check: Closed: wordmark and Index control are legible. Open: every numbered line and description is legible.
mobile: At 375px the panel takes full width, numbers keep a fixed 2.5rem column, and the Index control is 44px.
a11y: Index is a button with aria-expanded and aria-controls; the panel is a dialog that traps focus and returns it on close. Reduced motion: the panel appears without sliding.
avoid: Corner labels lost on busy hero photographs (keep the backing chip), or a panel with no visible close. Avoid the default fingerprint: wordmark left, centred links, button right.

stack_notes.css: position: fixed corners; the panel uses a transform translateX transition; dialog element with ::backdrop.
stack_notes.js: Toggle aria-expanded, trap focus and listen for Escape; remove listeners on unmount.

name: Overlay header that settles into a solid bar
blueprint: One compact row, 68-76px tall, laid over the hero picture: wordmark, the site's real links, one small call line and one primary button. Over the hero it is transparent with a faint scrim (or a light blur only where the picture is busy) and light text; once the hero leaves the viewport it settles into a solid light bar with dark text, a hairline under it and a 64px height. The wordmark swaps to its dark version at the same moment. Link hovers draw an underline from the left in the accent; the current page keeps it. A products link opens a panel of the real product lines, each with its picture, one-line use and its page link, not a plain list.
motion: Background, text colour and height change together in 200ms on one class switch triggered by an IntersectionObserver on the hero; underlines draw in 180ms; the products panel fades and drops 8px in 200ms.
still_check: Any still shows the full row readable over the hero and as the solid bar.
mobile: At 375px the row keeps the wordmark, a call icon link and a menu button; the menu opens a full-height sheet with the links, the product lines and the primary button at thumb reach.
a11y: Header is a banner landmark with a nav list; text over the hero keeps 4.5:1 via the scrim; the products button has aria-expanded and aria-controls, opens on Enter/Space/ArrowDown, closes on Escape and returns focus; the mobile sheet traps focus and closes on Escape. Reduced motion: colour switch only, no height or panel movement.
avoid: A tall masthead, a separate utility row, a second row of tabs, capsule pills, heavy glass on the solid state, a glow under the bar. Avoid the default fingerprint: centred links with a lone button and nothing in the products panel.

stack_notes.css: Fallback: position: sticky with the solid state when JS is off; the scrim is a gradient on the hero, not on the header.
stack_notes.js: One IntersectionObserver on the hero toggles a class on the header; disconnect it on unmount.

name: Header that steps aside and returns
blueprint: One row 4.5rem tall on the page ground: wordmark at inline-start, 4 to 5 destinations at 0.9375rem with 2rem gaps, and at inline-end a quiet text link (Contact) plus one primary button 2.5rem tall with 4px corners. Scrolling down past 120px moves the header out of view; any upward scroll brings it back as a 4rem bar with a 1px hairline under it and the ground at full opacity. At the very top it has no hairline. Current page link carries a 1px underline offset 6px; hover draws the same underline from inline-start. States: top, hidden, revealed, link hover, current, focus (2px ring offset 2px).
motion: Hide and reveal translate the header on Y over 220ms cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1); the hairline fades in 150ms on reveal. Threshold of 8px scroll delta before toggling so it never jitters.
still_check: Any still shows the full row at the top; a mid-page still shows either the revealed bar with hairline or no header.
mobile: At 375px the row keeps the wordmark and a Menu button 2.75rem square; the menu opens a full-height sheet with links at 1.5rem and the primary button at thumb reach. Same hide and reveal rule.
a11y: Banner landmark with a nav list; focus inside the header always reveals it; skip link first in order. Reduced motion: the header stays fixed and visible, no translate.
avoid: Hiding on tiny scroll deltas, a header that returns with a shadow or glow, capsule-shaped nav pills, or more than one button.

stack_notes.css: position: sticky; transform toggled by a data attribute; :focus-within forces the revealed state.
stack_notes.js: One passive scroll listener with requestAnimationFrame throttle comparing last scrollY; remove on unmount.

name: Full-screen menu with a picture per destination
blueprint: Header row 5rem tall, transparent over the hero: wordmark at inline-start, a Menu text button with a two-line icon at inline-end, nothing else. Menu opens a full-viewport panel on the dark ground split 7/12 and 5/12. Start: 4 to 6 destinations at clamp(2.5rem, 6vw, 5rem) in the display face, line-height 1.05, each with a small index number at 0.75rem tabular figures. End: a 4:5 picture of the hovered or focused destination, square-cornered, with a one-line caption under it. Panel foot: email, phone and social links at 0.875rem in one row. States: closed, open, link hover or focus (other links drop to 40% ink, picture swaps), current page (index number in accent).
motion: Open: panel fades in over 240ms, then links rise 24px with a 50ms stagger over 420ms cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1); pictures crossfade in 260ms on hover. Close reverses in 200ms with no stagger.
still_check: Any still with the menu open shows every link fully readable and one picture; closed state shows the clean header.
mobile: At 375px links set at clamp(2rem, 9vw, 2.75rem) in one column, pictures hidden, contact row pinned at the foot.
a11y: Menu button has aria-expanded and aria-controls; panel is a modal dialog with focus trap, Escape closes and returns focus; dimmed links stay at least 3:1 and full ink on focus. Reduced motion: no stagger or rise, instant crossfade.
avoid: Links dimmed below readability, auto-cycling pictures, more than 6 destinations, hamburger animations that morph through gimmick shapes, or hiding the contact details.

stack_notes.css: Grid panel with position fixed; pictures preloaded as small srcset images.
stack_notes.js: Toggle state, focus trap and hover index; preload pictures on menu-button hover; clean listeners on unmount.

name: Solutions mega panel for B2B ranges
blueprint: Single header row 4.5rem tall: wordmark, 4 top items (Products, Industries, Resources, Company), a phone link and a primary button 2.5rem tall with 4px corners (Request a quote). Products and Industries open a panel 100% wide under the bar, max content 80rem, 1px top hairline: start 8 columns hold 4 to 8 items in a 2-column grid, each with a 3rem thumbnail of the real product or sector, name at 1rem and one-line use at 0.875rem in the muted ink; end 4 columns hold one featured case (16:9 picture, client and result in one line, Read the case link). States: closed, open, item hover (tint 4%, name underlines), focus (2px ring offset 2px).
motion: Panel opens with a 6px drop and fade over 180ms; switching between Products and Industries crossfades content in 150ms without closing. 120ms hover intent delay before opening.
still_check: Any still with a panel open shows every item with thumbnail, name and use line plus the featured case.
mobile: At 375px the row keeps wordmark, phone icon link and Menu; the sheet lists top items as accordions with the same items and thumbnails, primary button pinned at the foot.
a11y: Top items are buttons with aria-expanded; panel opens on Enter, Space or ArrowDown, closes on Escape and returns focus; links are real anchors. Reduced motion: no drop, instant show.
avoid: Icon-only items, text-only walls of links, more than 8 items per panel, panels that close when the pointer crosses a gap, or stock imagery in the thumbnails.

stack_notes.css: Panel absolutely positioned under a sticky header; grid for items.
stack_notes.js: Disclosure pattern with hover intent; outside-click and Escape close; remove listeners on unmount.

name: Week hours footer
blueprint: The footer leads with a seven-column week strip, each day a cell at least 5.5rem wide showing the day name and opening hours in tabular figures; today's cell is filled in the accent with an Open now or Closed label. Under it, one row holds the address as a map link, the phone as a tel link and a short directions line. Site links and legal sit in one small final line. Block padding clamp(3rem, 7vw, 5rem).
motion: Only today's cell moves: its fill fades in over 300ms when the footer enters.
still_check: Any still shows all seven days with hours, today highlighted, address and phone.
mobile: At 375px the week strip becomes a two-column list (day, hours) with today first, then the rest in order.
a11y: The week strip is a list with day names spelled out for screen readers; status is text, not colour only. Reduced motion: fill shown at once.
avoid: Hours that go stale on holidays (needs an exceptions field), or seven cramped cells overflowing at tablet widths. Avoid four equal link columns.

stack_notes.css: grid-template-columns: repeat(7, minmax(5.5rem, 1fr)); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums.
stack_notes.js: Compute today and open status in the business time zone; refresh each minute and clear the interval on unmount.

name: Oversize signup sentence
blueprint: Footer led by one sentence at clamp(2.25rem, 6vw, 5rem) with text-wrap: balance on the page's own ground (or the inverted ground for dark brands), with the email field set into the line (Send me the [your email] letter): the field sized to 14ch, its 2px underline in the ink, a visible label above the sentence at 0.875rem small caps (Newsletter, monthly). The submit is a text button at the sentence end, Subscribe at 1rem with an arrow glyph and a 2px underline, 3rem tap target. One line under it says what arrives and how often. Below a 1px rule: site links in one row at 0.9375rem, legal at 0.8125rem. States: field focus (underline turns accent, 2px ring offset 4px), button hover (arrow moves 4px), success (sentence replaced by a thank-you line with aria-live).
motion: Button hover nudges the arrow 4px over 160ms; on success the sentence crossfades to the thank-you over 240ms.
still_check: Any still shows the full sentence with the field, the button and the link row.
mobile: At 375px the sentence wraps onto three lines, the field becomes full width at 1.25rem text, and the button sits under it at 3.5rem.
a11y: The field has a label for screen readers and autocomplete=email; results go to an aria-live region. Reduced motion: no turn, instant swap.
avoid: Circular submit buttons, accent-flooded grounds that drop contrast, placeholder-only labels, fields under 44px tall, or promises of frequency the brand cannot keep.

stack_notes.css: field-sizing: content where supported, else a ch-based width; the form posts without script.
stack_notes.js: Progressive enhancement: submit with fetch, fall back to a normal post, and announce the result.

name: Category shelf footer
blueprint: The footer opens with a shelf of six category tiles, each 9rem square with a small photograph or drawing and the category name under it, standing on a 4px shelf line. Below the shelf: delivery and returns promises as three short lines with icons, then help links, payment method marks and legal in a final row.
motion: Tiles lift 4px over 160ms on hover; nothing else moves.
still_check: Any still shows every tile with its name, the three promises and the final row.
mobile: At 375px the shelf becomes a horizontal scroll row with snap showing two and a half tiles; promises stack.
a11y: Tiles are links with text labels; images have empty alt because the label names them. Reduced motion: no lift.
avoid: Tiles that copy the main nav exactly, heavy footer images hurting load (lazy-load them), or invented payment marks that look like real brands. Avoid four equal link columns.

stack_notes.css: grid-auto-flow: column on mobile with scroll-snap; loading=lazy on tile images.
stack_notes.js: No script required.

name: Structured company footer
blueprint: Footer on a ground one step darker than the page, padding-block clamp(4rem, 8vw, 6rem). Row 1 on a 12-column grid: columns 1 to 4 hold the wordmark, one sentence on what the firm does, and a newsletter field 3rem tall with a visible label and 4px corners; columns 6 to 12 hold 4 link columns (Products, Industries, Company, Support) with headings at 0.8125rem small caps and 5 to 7 links at 0.9375rem with 0.625rem row gaps. Row 2 after a 1px hairline: offices as 2 to 3 short address blocks with phone links, and certifications as text marks with registration numbers. Row 3 after a hairline: legal links, company number and the copyright at 0.8125rem, language switch at inline-end. States: link hover (underline 1px offset 3px), focus (2px ring offset 2px).
motion: None on entry. Link underlines fade in over 120ms.
still_check: Any still shows every row with readable links, offices and legal line.
mobile: At 375px link columns become 2 by 2, then accordions under 22rem; offices stack; legal links wrap in one paragraph.
a11y: contentinfo landmark; link columns are nav elements with labelled headings; contrast 4.5:1 on the darker ground. Reduced motion: nothing to reduce.
avoid: Social icon rows as decoration, more than 4 link columns, logo walls of certifiers without numbers, back-to-top floating buttons, or newsletter fields without labels.

stack_notes.css: Grid with subgrid for column headings; details/summary for mobile accordions.
stack_notes.js: None required.

name: Footer as the closing chapter
blueprint: The last chapter of the page on the dark ground, padding-top clamp(5rem, 11vw, 10rem). First band: an invitation h2 at clamp(2.5rem, 6vw, 5.5rem) with text-wrap: balance (Let's build the next one), one sentence, a primary button 3.25rem tall with 4px corners and a direct email link at 1.25rem, beside a 4:5 photograph of the work or place on the inline-end 5 columns. Second band after a 1px rule at 15% opacity: 3 link columns at 0.9375rem, office address and phone, social as text links. Final line: legal at 0.8125rem and the wordmark at 1.5rem. All text 4.5:1. States: button hover (fill lightens 6%), link hover (underline draws from inline-start in 180ms), focus (2px ring offset 3px).
motion: As the band enters, the photograph scales 1.06 to 1 across its view range 0 to 60%; the h2 lines rise 16px with an 80ms stagger once. Nothing moves after.
still_check: Any still shows invitation, button, photograph and the link band readable.
mobile: At 375px the photograph goes above the h2 at 4:3, button full width, link columns stack.
a11y: contentinfo landmark; the invitation is an h2; photograph has alt text naming the project or place. Reduced motion: no scale or rise.
avoid: Duplicating a CTA section placed just above, stock photography, a second competing button, or footers padded taller than one viewport.

stack_notes.css: animation-timeline: view() for the photo scale with a static fallback.
stack_notes.js: None required.

name: The product, installed, at true scale
blueprint: Split hero for a B2B maker or installer: left, the h1 in two authored lines at clamp(2.75rem, 6vw, 6rem) naming what the firm builds and for whom, one sentence under it, the primary quote button and a secondary call or WhatsApp link; right, a real photograph of the product installed on a real site, cropped so its true size reads against people, doors or a street. Under both, a ruled strip of exactly three verifiable facts from the brief (warranty, range, service area). The primary button carries the page's one motif. Corner radius decided once for the page.
motion: Image settles from scale 1.04 to 1 over 900ms; h1 lines rise 12px with a 60ms stagger. Nothing loops.
still_check: Any still shows h1, both actions, the installed product and the three facts.
mobile: At 375px the photo moves under the actions and keeps a 4:3 crop that still shows scale.
a11y: One h1; image alt names the product and site; both actions are real links. Reduced motion: no rise, no scale.
avoid: Floating product cut-outs on gradients, invented project names, or a render passed off as an installation.

stack_notes.css: Grid split with a ruled facts strip.
stack_notes.js: None required.

name: Look inside the product
blueprint: Split hero: the product shot large on one side, and a circular lens that follows the pointer (or steps through three fixed points on touch and scroll) shows the build underneath, such as the module and its pitch, the cabinet depth or the weatherproofing, each with a one-line spec callout. The h1 sits in two lines at clamp(2.5rem, 5.5vw, 5.5rem) beside it with the quote button. The lens uses a second real close-up image, not a filter.
motion: Lens moves with the pointer via transform only; callouts fade 200ms. Three scroll stops on touch.
still_check: Any still shows the product, the h1, the quote button and the first callout.
mobile: At 375px the lens is replaced by three tappable close-ups in a row.
a11y: Callouts are real text in a list, not only on hover; keyboard can step the three points. Reduced motion: static close-ups side by side.
avoid: Inventing specs the brief does not give, or a lens over a stock render.

stack_notes.css: Static product shot plus a list of close-ups.
stack_notes.js: Pointer tracking with requestAnimationFrame; remove listeners on unmount.

name: The installation in its place
blueprint: Full-bleed hero video or photograph of the product working in its real setting (a lit screen on a facade at dusk, a line running in a plant), with a bottom scrim, the h1 in two lines at clamp(2.75rem, 6.5vw, 6.5rem) bottom-left, one supporting sentence, the quote button and a call link. A small caption names the setting or says Illustrative when it is a concept. Poster image set so LCP is the still.
motion: Video plays muted inline after the poster paints; h1 masks up line by line over 700ms.
still_check: Any still shows h1, actions, caption and a readable poster frame.
mobile: At 375px the poster crops to the product, the scrim deepens, and text stays 4.5:1.
a11y: Pause control for the video; captions honest about concept vs completed work. Reduced motion: poster only.
avoid: Autoplaying sound, unlabelled concept art posing as a client project, or text over busy footage without a scrim.

stack_notes.css: Video with poster and scrim.
stack_notes.js: None required.

name: Pick a model, see what changes
blueprint: One interactive tied to the product's deciding spec (pixel pitch, load rating, output): a segmented control of the real models, and for the chosen one a live preview (canvas or image) plus readouts of the brief's verified numbers, such as viewing distance, typical use and model name. Labelled Illustrative when the preview is a demonstration. Under it the same data as a plain table. h2 at clamp(1.75rem, 3.5vw, 3rem).
motion: Preview redraws in 250ms on change; readout numbers tween once.
still_check: Any still shows the control, a preview and the readouts for the default model.
mobile: At 375px the control scrolls horizontally and the readouts stack.
a11y: Control is a radio group; readouts in a live region; table always present. Reduced motion: no tween.
avoid: Inventing numbers, or a configurator with prices the brief does not give.

stack_notes.css: Radio group plus table.
stack_notes.js: Redraw on change; cancel animation frames on unmount.

name: The range, by where it goes
blueprint: Catalogue grouped by application, not by SKU: three to four bands (indoor, outdoor, specialist), each with a real product image, the two or three specs a buyer decides on, the places it suits, and a link to its real page. Bands alternate image side; no row of identical cards. h2 at clamp(1.75rem, 3.5vw, 3rem).
motion: Images reveal with a 400ms clip from the motif edge as each band enters.
still_check: Any still shows every band with its image, specs and link.
mobile: At 375px each band stacks image, specs, link.
a11y: Each band is an article with its own h3; links name the product. Reduced motion: no clip.
avoid: Icon cards, invented models, or prices the brief does not state.

stack_notes.css: Alternating grid bands.
stack_notes.js: None required.

name: From site survey to handover
blueprint: The real delivery sequence as an ordered list: survey, design, fabrication, installation, calibration, training and handover, each with what the client receives at that step and who does it. A thin line joins the steps and fills as the reader scrolls. h2 at clamp(1.75rem, 3.5vw, 3rem). Steps come from the brief; none invented.
motion: Connector line fills with scroll via a scroll timeline where supported; steps fade 200ms.
still_check: Any still shows every step and its deliverable.
mobile: At 375px the line runs down the left edge.
a11y: A real ol; no meaning carried by the line alone. Reduced motion: line drawn full.
avoid: Generic three-step icons, or durations the brief does not give.

stack_notes.css: Ordered list with a pseudo-element line.
stack_notes.js: None required.

name: Who it is installed for
blueprint: Proof built from what the brief verifies: a strip of real client logos at one height, then one or two quoted testimonials at clamp(1.5rem, 2.6vw, 2.25rem) with the client and site named, and the firm's one verifiable count. No metrics the brief does not give.
motion: Logos go from muted to full colour on hover; quotes fade in once.
still_check: Any still shows logos, quotes and attribution.
mobile: At 375px logos wrap to two rows; one quote shows at a time with a plain next button.
a11y: Logos have alt text with the client name; quotes in blockquote with cite. Reduced motion: no fade.
avoid: Fake star ratings, invented counters, or unnamed quotes.

stack_notes.css: Logo row and blockquotes.
stack_notes.js: Optional quote stepper; no autoplay.

name: Client wall that opens into cases
blueprint: Section inside max-width 80rem: a ruled head with the h2 at clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 2.25rem) and a count at inline-end (42 clients across 9 sectors). Then a grid of 8 to 12 cells, 4 per row on desktop, each cell 9rem tall bounded by 1px rules (no cards), holding one client wordmark in monochrome at 2rem height centred, 60% ink. Cells with a published case show a small Case label at 0.75rem at block-end and become links; hovering or focusing them brings the wordmark to full ink and reveals one result line at 0.875rem (Response time down 38%). A sector filter of 4 to 5 text tabs sits above the grid. States: idle, cell hover or focus (full ink, result line in), filtered (non-matching cells drop to 20% and lose link focus), focus (2px ring offset -2px).
motion: Hover reveals the result line by rising 6px and fading in over 180ms; filtering crossfades cells over 200ms.
still_check: Any still shows every wordmark legible and the count.
mobile: At 375px 2 cells per row, result lines always visible under case cells, filter as a scrollable row.
a11y: Wordmarks are images with the client name as alt; filter is a tablist; result lines are in the DOM, not tooltips. Reduced motion: result lines always visible.
avoid: Coloured logos, auto-scrolling logo marquees, clients without permission, As-seen-in claims, or more than 12 cells.

stack_notes.css: Grid with border collapse via gap: 1px on a line-coloured background.
stack_notes.js: Optional filter toggling data attributes.

name: One testimonial, carried by its result
blueprint: One quote given the whole section, max-width 72rem, two columns 7/12 and 5/12. Start: the quote at clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 2.5rem) in the display or reading face with text-wrap: pretty, max 60 words, hanging punctuation, no quote-mark graphic; under it the person's name at 1rem, role and company at 0.875rem, and a 3rem portrait inline at start. End, bounded by a 1px rule at inline-start: the measured result as a figure at clamp(2.5rem, 6vw, 4.5rem) in tabular figures with its label, the time frame and a link Read the case study. If there are 2 or 3 quotes, previous and next text buttons with a 1 of 3 count sit under the figure. States: link hover (underline 2px), focus (2px ring offset 2px), quote change.
motion: Changing quotes crossfades quote and figure together over 260ms with a 8px rise; nothing autoplays.
still_check: Any still shows the full quote, attribution and result figure.
mobile: At 375px the figure moves under the attribution; quote at clamp(1.25rem, 5vw, 1.5rem).
a11y: figure with blockquote and figcaption; controls are buttons with labels; change announced politely. Reduced motion: instant swap.
avoid: Anonymous or invented quotes, star graphics, auto-rotating carousels, quotes over 60 words, or a result figure without its time frame.

stack_notes.css: Grid; hanging-punctuation where supported.
stack_notes.js: Optional prev/next state for 2 to 3 quotes.

name: Request a site survey or quote
blueprint: Closing quote section on the dark chapter: the h2 at clamp(2rem, 4.5vw, 4rem), a short form with the fields this trade needs (name, company, phone, city, site type, approximate size, timeline), honest about how it is sent, and beside it the phone, WhatsApp, email and address as direct links. No fake success state.
motion: Focus ring appears in 150ms; nothing else moves.
still_check: Any still shows the form, contact links and hours.
mobile: At 375px contact links come first, the form under them.
a11y: Visible labels, inline errors, honeypot, works without JS via mailto or WhatsApp. Reduced motion: nothing to reduce.
avoid: Pretending to submit to a server that does not exist, or asking for more than a quote needs.

stack_notes.css: Two-column form and contact block.
stack_notes.js: Client-side validation; build the message link on submit.

name: Closing band over the picture
blueprint: Full-bleed band clamp(28rem, 70svh, 44rem) tall with one photograph or muted loop of the finished work or place, a gradient scrim to 65% ink over the start half. On columns 1 to 6 of the 12-column grid, vertically centred: a label at 0.8125rem small caps, the h2 at clamp(2.25rem, 5vw, 4.5rem) with text-wrap: balance naming the next step, one sentence on what happens after you act, and a primary button 3.25rem tall with 4px corners plus a direct phone or email link at 1.0625rem. States: button hover (fill lightens 6%), pressed (depresses 1px), focus (2px ring offset 3px).
motion: Across the band's view range the image moves 8% slower than the page (parallax by translate only); the text block rises 16px once on entry over 500ms.
still_check: Any still shows h2, sentence, button and contact link at 4.5:1 over the scrim.
mobile: At 375px the band becomes the image at 4:3 with the text block below on solid ink, button full width.
a11y: Image decorative (alt empty) unless it shows a named project; video has a pause control. Reduced motion: no parallax or rise.
avoid: Stock imagery, two competing primary buttons, centred text floating over a busy frame, or urgency timers.

stack_notes.css: animation-timeline: view() translate for parallax; gradient scrim layer.
stack_notes.js: None required.

name: Talk to a named person
blueprint: Closing CTA inside max-width 72rem with a 1px border and 6px corners, two columns 5/12 and 7/12. Start: a portrait of the real person who answers at 4:5, 16rem wide, square-cornered, with name at 1.125rem, role at 0.875rem and their direct line and email as links. End: the h2 at clamp(1.75rem, 3.5vw, 2.75rem) with text-wrap: balance (Talk to Mira about your project), 3 short lines on what the first call covers and how long it takes, then a primary button 3.25rem tall with 4px corners (Book a 30-minute call) and a secondary text link (Or send the brief). A line under the button states the reply time. States: button hover (fill darkens 8%), focus (2px ring offset 2px).
motion: Button press depresses 1px in 120ms. Nothing else.
still_check: Any still shows the portrait, name, h2, button and reply time.
mobile: At 375px the portrait becomes a 4rem circle beside the name above the h2; button full width.
a11y: Portrait alt names the person; booking link opens in the same tab or says it opens a new one. Reduced motion: nothing to reduce.
avoid: Stock headshots, generic sales@ addresses as the only route, chat-bubble widgets, or calendars embedded inline that load slowly.

stack_notes.css: Grid with a bordered container; tokens for colours.
stack_notes.js: None required; booking via a link to the scheduler.

name: Which one fits my site?
blueprint: A decision guide for buyers: three questions as rows (how far away do people stand, indoors or out, flat or curved) with the brief's real answer ranges, each pointing to the product that fits. Reads as a ruled table, not cards. h2 at clamp(1.75rem, 3.5vw, 3rem).
motion: Row highlights on hover and focus in 150ms.
still_check: Any still shows every question and its answer.
mobile: At 375px each row stacks question, answer, product.
a11y: A table with caption and row headers. Reduced motion: no highlight transition.
avoid: Ranges the brief does not state.

stack_notes.css: Ruled table.
stack_notes.js: None required.

name: Blank wall, then switched on
blueprint: Stacked hero for a maker whose product changes a place: the h1 in two lines at clamp(2.75rem, 6vw, 6rem) with one sentence, the quote button and a call link sit above one wide frame. In the frame, the same real site photographed twice (before: a blank facade, wall or stage; after: the product installed and working), joined by a draggable divider that starts at 50%. One short caption names the site, or says Illustrative when the after image is a concept. The divider handle carries the page's one motif.
motion: Divider eases from 35% to 50% once on load over 700ms; dragging follows the pointer with transform only. Nothing loops.
still_check: Any still shows the h1, both actions, and both halves of the frame split at 50% with the caption.
mobile: At 375px the frame keeps 4:3, the divider becomes a two-button toggle (Before / After) above it.
a11y: The divider is a range input with a label; both images carry alt text naming before and after. Reduced motion: no load ease, the frame rests at 50%.
avoid: A before image from a different site, a render presented as a completed installation, or a slider with no keyboard control.

stack_notes.css: Two stacked images with clip-path driven by a custom property set from a range input.
stack_notes.js: Pointer and keyboard drive the custom property; remove listeners on unmount.

name: The module, held up close
blueprint: Centred hero for a maker whose product is built from parts: one real close-up photograph of the core part (an LED module face, a cabinet edge, a machined joint) sits centre-stage at large scale on a flat ground, with the h1 in two authored lines at clamp(2.5rem, 6vw, 6rem) set above it and one sentence, the quote button and a call link below. Two or three short callouts on hairline leaders name what the eye sees (pitch, depth, finish), using only the brief's real specs. The primary button carries the page's one motif.
motion: The close-up settles from scale 1.06 to 1 over 900ms; leaders draw in 300ms each after it. Nothing loops.
still_check: Any still shows the h1, the close-up, the callouts and both actions.
mobile: At 375px the close-up fills the width, callouts become a short list under it, actions stay above the fold.
a11y: One h1; alt names the part and its spec; callouts are real text, not baked into the image. Reduced motion: no scale, leaders drawn.
avoid: Renders passed off as photos, invented specs, glow halos around the part.

stack_notes.css: Centred grid with absolutely placed leaders that collapse to a list.
stack_notes.js: None required.

name: Full-bleed film with a held statement
blueprint: Hero 100svh (min 36rem), full-bleed loop of 8 to 14 seconds shot for the brand: the place, the product in use, the team at work, graded to the brand palette, with a poster frame that is the LCP image. A gradient scrim from 0 at 45% height to 60% ink at the bottom. Bottom-left on the 12-column grid, columns 1 to 7: a small label at 0.8125rem small caps (sector or place), the h1 in two authored lines at clamp(2.75rem, 6.5vw, 6.25rem) with text-wrap: balance, one sentence at 1.125rem, a primary button 3.25rem tall with 4px corners and a text link. Bottom-right: a pause control 2.75rem square and a 1-line caption naming the footage. States: playing, paused, button hover (fill darkens 8%), focus (2px ring offset 3px).
motion: Poster paints first; video fades in over 400ms once it can play through. h1 lines unmask upward with a 90ms stagger over 700ms; sentence and actions follow at 200ms. Scroll 0-100% of the hero: video scales 1 to 1.05 and the text block rises 4vh.
still_check: Any still shows the poster frame, h1, sentence, actions and pause control readable at 4.5:1.
mobile: At 375px a 9:16 cut or a poster crop focused on the subject; h1 at clamp(2.25rem, 10vw, 3rem); actions stack full width; video skipped on save-data.
a11y: Video is muted, aria-hidden, with a labelled pause button; h1 is real text. Reduced motion: poster only, no scale or unmask.
avoid: Stock drone footage, cuts faster than 2 seconds, text over busy frames without a scrim, autoplay with sound, or a centred headline floating mid-frame.

stack_notes.css: video with poster, playsinline, muted, loop; scrim as a gradient layer; animation-timeline for the scroll scale.
stack_notes.js: Pause toggle and save-data check; IntersectionObserver pauses off-screen.

name: Statement with an evidence strip
blueprint: Stacked hero inside max-width 80rem, padding clamp(4rem, 9vw, 8rem) clamp(1rem, 4vw, 3rem). Row 1 on 12 columns: the h1 at clamp(2.5rem, 5.5vw, 5rem) with text-wrap: balance on columns 1 to 8; on columns 9 to 12, aligned to the h1's last baseline, one sentence at 1.125rem and the primary button 3rem tall with 4px corners plus a secondary text link. Row 2: one wide photograph of the real work at 21:9, square-cornered. Row 3, directly under the photo: an evidence strip of 4 cells divided by 1px rules, each a figure at clamp(1.75rem, 3vw, 2.5rem) in tabular figures with a 2-line label at 0.875rem (Years operating, Projects delivered, Countries, Average response). Row 4: 5 to 6 client names as monochrome wordmarks at 1.75rem height, 50% ink. States: button hover (fill darkens 8%), focus (2px ring offset 2px).
motion: Load: h1 lines rise 12px with an 80ms stagger; the photograph unmasks from 96% to 100% width over 700ms; figures count up once over 900ms when the strip enters view.
still_check: Any still shows h1, actions, photograph and all four figures with labels.
mobile: At 375px the sentence and actions follow the h1, the photo goes 4:3, the strip becomes 2 by 2, and wordmarks wrap to two rows.
a11y: Figures are real text; count-up announces only the final value; wordmarks have alt names. Reduced motion: figures static, no unmask.
avoid: Unsourced or rounded-up vanity figures, more than 4 figures, coloured client logos, stock photography, or a gradient blob behind the headline.

stack_notes.css: Grid with baseline alignment; strip as a 4-column grid with border-inline-start.
stack_notes.js: Optional count-up via IntersectionObserver; final values in the HTML.

name: Statement, then the image opens to full bleed
blueprint: Section 200svh with a 100svh sticky stage. First screen: the h1 at clamp(3rem, 8vw, 7.5rem) with text-wrap: balance set across columns 1 to 10, one sentence at 1.125rem and a text link, on the plain ground. Below the type, one photograph (or poster video) inset to 60% of the content width at 16:10 with 2px corners. As the stage scrolls, the picture expands to full bleed 100vw by 100svh and the corners go square; a caption at 0.8125rem names the place or project once it is full. States: inset, expanding, full, link hover (underline 2px), focus (2px ring offset 2px).
motion: Scroll 0-70% of the section: clip-path inset on the picture goes from 20% sides and 12% top to 0 while the image inside scales 1.12 to 1, so it seems to open rather than zoom; the h1 drifts up 10vh and fades to 0 at 60%. 70-100%: picture holds, caption fades in over 200ms.
still_check: At 0% the h1 and inset picture are both fully visible; at 50% the picture is about 80% open with the h1 still readable above; at 100% the full-bleed picture with caption.
mobile: At 375px no pin: h1, sentence, then the picture at 4:5 full width with a single 1.04 to 1 scale on view.
a11y: h1 never depends on scroll to be read; the picture has alt text. Reduced motion: picture shown full width at 16:10 under the h1, no clip-path animation.
avoid: A picture that is decoration rather than the work or place, heavy scroll jacking, letterboxing during expansion, or text over the expanded picture without a scrim.

stack_notes.css: animation-timeline: scroll() on the sticky section driving clip-path and scale; @supports fallback to static.
stack_notes.js: Fallback: one scroll-progress variable set in requestAnimationFrame.
